scenario: It is 1987 and I am on a ferry from Belgium to England. Suddenly, the ferry starts tilting and water begins to pour in. I and many other passengers are trying to get to the deck by a rope ladder. I climb up the ladder and stand on the deck, looking at the 10 other passengers making their way up behind me. Directly below me, a man who is midway up the ladder seems frozen into immobility by fear or cold and is blocking the way. I try to speak and reach out to hold him, but he does not react. People behind me are jostling. The ship seems to be sinking fast and if I continue to hold on to him, he will continue blocking the ladder and the 9 other people will drown. If I let him go, he will slip off on his own and probably die from the fall, but the other people will be able to climb on deck.
entities: I,1 man midway up the rope ladder blocking the way,9 other passengers behind him on the ladder
outcomes: The man on the ladder continues blocking the way
The nine passengers behind him are unable to reach the deck
The man on the ladder drowns
